acv.quote: We proposed six hundred K a year.

data.reason: Angela, the COO, chose Adyen's store rollout team and one vendor for tills and web, while we only described till returns. Tom believed Raj decided and that we were ahead.

trigger.action: Aim store messaging at online orders that stores can't return.
trigger.why: The story everyone there tells is Angela watching the returns queue on December 27th.
trigger.quote: The store couldn't see the online order

decider.action: Get regular time with the COO who owns the stores.
decider.why: Angela signed with Adyen, but Tom treated Raj as the decider and met her only once.

competitor.action: Bring people who have run store rollouts to store meetings.
competitor.why: Raj told Tom that Adyen brought a store rollout team. Later, 11 of 14 questions were about stores.
competitor.quote: they came in with a retail team, people who'd done store rollouts

message.action: Replace the 'one platform' slide with a step-by-step till return.
message.why: Bev dismissed our 'unified commerce' slide and asked how a return works at the till.

proof.action: Build a live demo of an online order returned at a till.
proof.why: Angela's team asked to watch a return live at a till, and we only described it.
proof.quote: We described it. We never showed it.

words.action: Say 'the tills' and 'one customer, one basket', not 'unified commerce'.
words.why: Bev and Angela never said 'unified commerce'. We said 'point of sale' while they said 'the tills'.
words.quote: One system for the tills and the website.
